mapper.sql: id, parent_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_type, api_path, sort_num, description, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from sys_permission order by sort_num asc, id asc
select count(*) from sys_permission where parent_id = #{parentId}
select count(*) from sys_permission where id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_permission(parent_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_type, api_path, sort_num, description, status, created_at, updated_at) values(#{parentId}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionName}, #{permissionType}, #{apiPath}, #{sortNum}, #{description}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_permission set parent_id = #{parentId}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, permission_name = #{permissionName}, permission_type = #{permissionType}, api_path = #{apiPath}, sort_num = #{sortNum}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct p.permission_code from sys_permission p inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join sys_role r on r.id = rp.role_id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 'ACTIVE'
